_comment: Main reading for HSK words where anchoring on the HSK-list pinyin and pypinyin's phrase reading picks the wrong CC-CEDICT reading (see app/services/readings.py). The HSK list's pinyin is just its first CC-CEDICT form, so it is often the rare reading; pypinyin's single-character default is sometimes the rarer one too; and for compounds the neutral-tone reading is preferred, which is wrong for a few words. Each entry was checked by hand against CC-CEDICT and the reading an HSK textbook teaches for that level. Tone-marked pinyin, syllables space-separated; 'why' says what goes wrong without the pin.

个.why: HSK list: gě (only in 自个儿)

地.why: HSK list: de '-ly'; dì 'earth' is the HSK 1 word, de stays as the other reading

子.why: pypinyin and SUBTLEX: the zi suffix reading

为.why: HSK list: wéi 'as'; HSK 2 teaches wèi 'for; because of', wéi stays as the other reading

弹.why: HSK list and pypinyin: dàn 'crossball'; HSK 5 teaches tán 'to play (an instrument)'

幢.why: HSK list and pypinyin: chuáng 'banner'; the HSK word is the classifier for buildings

正当.why: HSK list and pypinyin: zhèng dāng 'timely'; HSK 6 teaches zhèngdàng 'legitimate; proper'

精神.why: neutral-tone preference: jīng shen 'vigor'; HSK 3 teaches jīngshén 'spirit'

利害.why: neutral-tone preference: lì hai, a variant of 厉害

跟前.why: neutral-tone preference: gēn qian 'at one's side'

说道.why: neutral-tone preference: shuō dao 'to discuss'; narration uses shuōdào 'to say'

处.why: scorer: chǔ 'to reside'; HSK 4 teaches chù 'place; department' (chǔ stays as the other reading, as in 处理)

当天.why: HSK list: dāng tiān; dictionaries give dàngtiān 'that very day'

当日.why: HSK list: dāng rì; dictionaries give dàngrì 'that very day'

挨.why: scorer: āi 'in order'; HSK 6 teaches ái 'to suffer; to endure' (āi stays as the other reading)

晃.why: scorer: huǎng 'to dazzle'; the everyday verb is huàng 'to sway; to shake'

拽.why: scorer: zhuāi 'to throw'; the everyday verb is zhuài 'to pull'
